units.source_text: 我时常与诗人托喀一起去参加音乐会。

en.t: I often went to concerts together with the poet Tock.

units.source_text: 其中第三次音乐会的情景让我到现在还记忆犹新。

en.t: Of those concerts, the scene at the third one still remains vivid in my memory even now.

units.source_text: 会场的布置跟日本并无二致，座位也是一排排从低到高排列，

en.t: The arrangement of the hall was no different from one in Japan, and the seats too were set out in rows rising from low to high,

units.source_text: 三四百只河童都手上捏着节目单，全神贯注地倾听着。

en.t: while three or four hundred kappa all held programs in their hands and listened with complete attention.

units.source_text: 第三次去参加音乐会的时候，和我坐在一起的，

en.t: When I went to the concert for the third time, those sitting with me

units.source_text: 不仅有托喀和他的雌河童，还有哲学家马咯。

en.t: included not only Tock and his female kappa, but also the philosopher Magg.
We all sat in the front row.

units.source_text: 大提琴独奏节目结束之后，

en.t: After the cello solo on the program had ended,

units.source_text: 一只有着一对眯缝眼儿的河童抱着琴谱轻轻松松地登上了舞台。

en.t: a kappa with a pair of narrow, squinting eyes came lightly onto the stage holding a score.

units.source_text: 节目单里有介绍，这是著名作曲家库拉巴喀。

en.t: According to the program note, this was the famous composer Craback.

units.source_text: 节目单上印着他的名字（根本不用看节目单：库拉巴喀和托喀一样，也是超人俱乐部的会员，我知道他）：“Lied-Craback”。

en.t: His name was printed on the program, though I had no need to look at it: Craback, like Tock, was also a member of the Superman Club, and I knew him: "Lied-Craback."

units.source_text: （河童国的节目单基本上都是使用德文。）

en.t: The programs in Kappa Country were generally written in German.
